binary_hostile_control.scope: Finite-field hostile control only. It is not a positive-definite integral lattice, endpoint M alphabet/profile, incidence object, or graph.

forbidden_three_row_motif.graph_class_translation: For actual target incidence, no r=2 triangle pair may have a common triangle that is r=3 from both endpoints.
forbidden_three_row_motif.rootless_consequence: No three frame rows may have pairwise M-values -2,-2,-1.

hostile_premise_controls.drop_minimum_four: A norm-four row may have two orthogonal norm-two components; block support then fails.

drop_primitivity.conclusion: full column rank alone does not make rows generate

hostile_premise_controls.motif_absence: No current identity proves tr(A_minus1 A_minus2^2)>0; absence cannot be inferred from the positive global pair counts.

motif_trace_reduction.identity: tr(A_minus1 A_minus2^2) equals twice the number of unordered {-2,-2,-1} motifs

scope: Exact reductions for the rootless integrally indecomposable n3=708 endpoint branch; no endpoint or target exclusion.

support_connectivity.consequence: Under actual target incidence, every surviving rootless endpoint S-form is necessarily integrally indecomposable.

norm_four_block_support.conclusion: exactly one nonzero orthogonal component per row
norm_four_block_support.premises: even orthogonal summands, each of minimum at least 4

support_connectivity.primitive_basis_to_row_generation: For a primitive rank-44 column lattice X Z^44 in Z^231, Smith normal form has 44 unit invariant factors. The row lattice X^T Z^231 is therefore Z^44.
support_connectivity.support_graph_equivalence: Because the frame rows generate Z^44, disconnected nonzero support of M=XSX^T gives an integral orthogonal split; conversely a rootless integral split makes every row block-supported and disconnects that support.
